components.tab strip: GAP:ruled:834d4089 — new pattern composed entirely from existing tokens (ghost buttons, bracket-glyph active marker per node 9b0e63ee), not a new design-system primitive; native overflow-x scroll + stopPropagation() on touch, per node 834d4089
components.each tab: existing:ghost-button recipe (Card.svelte's own fullscreen-btn CSS), active tab wrapped in brackets per the [ + ]/[ MOTYW: JASNY ] convention
components.tab problem-state glyph: existing:Card.svelte GLYPH map ([!]/[X]), reused verbatim — see node 855ab1c4
components.per-event colour tick: GAP:ruled:33cd6c5b — dynamically computed per-calendar hue (JS math, not CSS colour functions), not a fixed token set; exact lightness/chroma tuning deferred to implementation
components.synthetic full-day error event: existing:K7Calendar.svelte's own event markup, reused for a CalendarEvent-shaped error placeholder — see node 855ab1c4

states.single-calendar (today, regression basel: No tab strip renders at all when calendars.length === 1 — pixel-identical to the current card, zero visual change.
states.multi-calendar, main tab (GŁÓWNY): Merged view of every Calendar with showInMain:true; per-event colour tick by source calendar.
states.multi-calendar, one calendar's own tab: Only that Calendar's events, regardless of its showInMain value — same mechanics as the main tab, single source.
states.empty: Falls out of the existing per-day '—' handling — an empty week is just seven empty days. No new design.
states.loading: Each calendar's tab updates progressively as its own fetch resolves (per-calendar independent fetch, already in plan.md) — no spinner, matching this project's stated aversion to spinners that might never resolve. No new design.
states.degraded — stale, cache available: That calendar's own tab gets a trailing [!] glyph (Card.svelte's existing GLYPH vocabulary); events shown are last-good from cache, not visually dimmed; card footer badge reflects worst-case state across all configured calendars.
states.degraded — no cache ever: That calendar's tab gets [X]; every day in that calendar's own bucket shows a synthetic all-day 'błąd wczytywania' event, scoped to that calendar only so one broken source doesn't flood the merged main view.

behavior: Tapping a tab switches which CalendarEvents feed the week grid.
GŁÓWNY merges every Calendar with showInMain:true; any other tab shows only that one Calendar.
Tab strip scrolls horizontally (native overflow-x) when it doesn't fit; touch events on the strip call stopPropagation() so a tab-scroll can never also register as a page swipe.

Tab labels truncate with an ellipsis at a fixed max-width, never wrap; full name available via the title attribute (hover-only — not a reliable touch affordance on the real device, so the truncated label must stay recognizable on its own).
